topic: Kakashi's Sharingan was a debt, not a gift: it drained him for life and finally cost him his life against Pain
title: Kakashi's Sharingan Was Never A Free Gift To Him
description: Obito handed Kakashi a Sharingan at Kannabi Bridge, but Kakashi is not an Uchiha, so every use drains him. Here is how that gift nearly killed him twice. Do you think Kakashi ever got the better end of the deal?
comment: Was Obito's gift a blessing or a curse for Kakashi? Pick one.

lines.text: Kakashi's Sharingan was never a gift. It was a debt.

shot.fallback: one eyed ninja with a scar over a red eye

lines.text: Obito gave him that eye on the battlefield at Kannabi Bridge.

shot.fallback: dying boy with goggles beside a masked boy, collapsed bridge

lines.text: It looked like a blessing, but Kakashi isn't an Uchiha.

shot.fallback: young ninja with silver hair holding his eye

lines.text: So he can't switch it off, and it bleeds his chakra all day long.

shot.fallback: silver haired ninja bedridden and pale

lines.text: Here's the part I think people forget.

shot.fallback: silver haired ninja looking at his glowing hand

lines.text: In Kakashi Gaiden, his Chidori kills Rin, and that is what awakens the Mangekyo.

shot.fallback: lightning hand through a girl, ninja horrified

lines.text: So the upgrade came from the worst day of his life.

shot.fallback: red eye with a pinwheel pattern, tears

lines.text: Then Kamui makes it worse. Every use eats chakra a normal ninja barely has.

shot.fallback: spiral vortex sucking a missile away

lines.text: Some people say he mastered it later, and yes, he got more uses out of it.

shot.fallback: ninja with a spinning eye standing calm

lines.text: But against Pain, he warped one missile away and burned out completely.

shot.fallback: ninja collapsing before a pierced ninja in a ruined village

lines.text: He died with that eye open, reaching for the friend who gave it to him.

shot.fallback: ninja lying in a white void with three smiling figures

lines.text: So the gift kept collecting, right to the end.

shot.fallback: one eyed ninja looking at his hand

lines.text: Because Kakashi's Sharingan was never a gift...

shot.fallback: one eyed ninja with a scar over a red eye
